# Runtime dependencies. The web framework and schema libraries are pinned exactly (DEF-06): the frozen OpenAPI
# contract in docs/contracts/fastapi-openapi.json is generated by these versions, and open ranges let CI resolve
# newer releases whose schema output differs (contentMediaType vs format: binary). Bump them together with the
# contract: python -m scripts.export_openapi, review the diff, commit both.
